name: default
description: The finished video looked at: two frames of every shot, and the shots with a problem (D121, Dark Palace's revisor PEDIDO)
system:
These are frames from a finished documentary video: two frames per shot, the shot number in yellow over the first of its two frames. OUR OWN graphics are fine: clean white captions at the bottom, titled boxes, counters, labels, bullet lists, maps, timelines, cards, framed photos, a title card, a subscribe button in the top-right corner. Find the shots with a PROBLEM:
- "logo": a SMALL channel logo or watermark sitting in one corner of the footage; say which corner.
- "foreign_text": other text or graphics that are NOT ours: TV news banners or tickers, 'BREAKING NEWS', burned-in subtitles in any language, big titles, a website or phone screenshot.
- "cut_off": our own text cut off at the frame's edge or spilling out of its box.
- "blank": black, blank or broken frames.
Most shots have no problem. Report only what you can see.
